text:
Ethan R (partnerships): Heads-up from Azure SI: they want a Marketplace-ready terraform module + reference arch for Redwood Private on AKS. Need conformity checklist and a publishing plan.
Priya M (cloud-partners): Key asks: module must support managed identity (MSI), VNet peering, Azure KeyVault integration, and a minimal monitoring sink (Log Analytics). Also: comply with Azure Marketplace SAR7 listing requirements.
Noah T (eng-platform): Suggest we provide two flavors: `azure/aks` (opinionated, faster setup) and `azure/aks-lite` (minimal infra, partner-managed networking). Share common module core via a `modules/core` folder.
Aisha L (devex): For quickstart: example repo, `deploy.sh`, `ci.tfvars`, and a tiny smoke test that validates ingress + health endpoint. I'll author sample helm values for our chart.
Marco G (marketplace): Publishing checklist items: module tar.gz, module registry entry, partner-friendly README, licensing blurb, package manifest for Marketplace (icon, short desc). We also need ARM64 notes for upstream images.
Priya M (cloud-partners): Security checklist: least-privilege roles for partner SREs, KeyVault access policy example, and steps to rotate credentials. Need an explicit note about customer-managed keys vs platform keys.
Noah T (eng-platform): CI matrix idea: run GH Actions against terraform 1.4/1.5, azurerm provider pinned to supported range, and run `terraform validate`, `tflint`, and `checkov` scan. We'll include a mock subscription using the Azure Dev Test Labs creds for plan-only.
Aisha L (devex): Draft GH Action snippet (validate + publish):
```yaml
name: Module CI
on: [pull_request, push]
jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Terraform
        uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v2
        with:
          terraform_version: 1.5.0
      - run: terraform fmt -check
      - run: terraform init -backend=false
      - run: terraform validate
      - run: tflint --init && tflint || true
      - name: Security scan
        run: checkov -d . || true
  publish:
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: ./scripts/build-module-package.sh
      - run: ./scripts/publish-to-registry.sh
```
Marco G (marketplace): Add a `marketplace/` folder with `manifest.json` and `images/`. We'll need marketing copy and a 2-min video clip for the listing.
Priya M (cloud-partners): Acceptance criteria for partner pilot: 1) module deploys in partner subscription with default vars within 15 minutes, 2) KeyVault integration validated, 3) Log Analytics receives heartbeat, 4) smoke test returns HTTP 200 on health endpoint.
Noah T (eng-platform): Ops note: keep outputs stable (cluster_api_server, kubeconfig_secret, keyvault_uri) and avoid renaming outputs between minor versions. Semantic versioning required.
Aisha L (devex): I'll create `examples/azure/partner-demo` with docs and `ci.tfvars.example`. Will also add an ARM64 note and image tag strategy.
Ethan R (partnerships): Owners: @Noah T handles module code and CI, @Aisha L does quickstart/docs/examples, @Marco G owns marketplace packaging, @Priya M will run partner validation. Timeline: skeleton repo by EOD Tue, initial PR by Fri, pilot run in 2 weeks.
Marketplace Bot: publish-check/run 7 — manifest lint OK, images present.
